{
  "contract_id": "contract_dna_replication_local_fork_v1",
  "topic_id": "dna_replication",
  "scope": {
    "user_request": "Review a grades10-12 Section4 video showing local fork opening, RNA priming, leading/lagging extension, one local primer replacement and nick sealing. Origins/licensing are covered in Section2; no whole-genome completion claim.",
    "audience": "grades_10_12",
    "included": [
      "Local replication fork opening by helicase",
      "RNA primer formation by primase",
      "Leading-strand continuous synthesis by pol ε",
      "Lagging-strand discontinuous synthesis by pol δ",
      "One local RNA primer removal on lagging strand by RNase H",
      "Local replacement with DNA nucleotides",
      "Nick sealing by DNA ligase"
    ],
    "excluded": [
      "Origin licensing and pre-replication complex assembly",
      "Whole-genome replication completion claims",
      "Telomere maintenance and telomerase action",
      "Cancer and aging telomere topics",
      "Detailed polymerase switching beyond pol α handoff"
    ]
  },
  "scientific_entities": [
    {
      "role": "replication_fork",
      "description": "Local Y-shaped junction where parental DNA unwinds and two daughter strands are synthesized",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "helicase_enzyme",
      "description": "Enzyme that uses ATP hydrolysis to open the DNA helix at the fork",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "primase_enzyme",
      "description": "Enzyme that forms RNA primers",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "rna_primer",
      "description": "Short RNA segment synthesized by primase that provides a starting point for DNA polymerase",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "dna_pol_alpha",
      "description": "DNA polymerase that adds a short DNA fragment to the RNA primer on both strands before handing off",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "dna_pol_epsilon",
      "description": "DNA polymerase that continuously synthesizes the leading strand",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "dna_pol_delta",
      "description": "DNA polymerase that synthesizes the lagging strand",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "leading_strand",
      "description": "DNA strand synthesized continuously by pol ε",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "lagging_strand",
      "description": "DNA strand synthesized discontinuously in short stretches (Okazaki fragments) by pol δ",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "okazaki_fragment",
      "description": "Short stretch of DNA synthesized on the lagging strand, initiated by a separate primer",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "rnase_h_enzyme",
      "description": "Enzyme that removes displaced RNA primer from the lagging strand",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "dna_ligase_enzyme",
      "description": "Enzyme that seals gaps by forming phosphodiester bonds after RNA primer replacement",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "phosphodiester_bond",
      "description": "Chemical bond formed by DNA ligase to seal nicks between Okazaki fragments",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    }
  ],
  "required_processes": [
    {
      "role": "fork_opening",
      "description": "Helicase opens the DNA helix, forming the replication fork",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "rna_priming",
      "description": "Primase forms RNA primers on both strands for DNA polymerase to start synthesis",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "leading_strand_synthesis",
      "description": "Pol ε continuously synthesizes the leading strand using the primer",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "lagging_strand_synthesis",
      "description": "Pol δ synthesizes the lagging strand in short stretches, each initiated by a separate primer",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "primer_replacement",
      "description": "RNase H removes displaced RNA primer; DNA nucleotides replace it",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "role": "nick_sealing",
      "description": "DNA ligase seals remaining gaps by forming phosphodiester bonds",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    }
  ],

    "Local fork opening with helicase separating DNA strands",
    "RNA primer visibly synthesized by primase on both leading and lagging strands",
    "Leading strand extended continuously by pol ε",
    "Lagging strand extended in short stretches by pol δ, each with a separate primer",
    "One local RNA primer on lagging strand removed by RNase H and replaced with DNA",
